nodes.name: agent-adapter-layer-verification-2026-07-05.md
nodes.summary: Code-only verification report (dated 2026-07-05) confirming ORG2's agent adapter layer is a session adapter/orchestration layer supporting both CLI-subprocess-backed agents and native/API Rust-backed agents behind a common SessionAdapter contract, with a claim-verification table citing exact file:line evidence.

nodes.name: cursor-ide-metadata.md
nodes.summary: Reference document detailing where Cursor IDE stores session/conversation data locally (conversation-search.db, state.vscdb) and how ORGII's sources/cursor_ide pipeline discovers, reads, and normalizes composerData fields from that store.

nodes.name: external-history-loader-metadata.md
nodes.summary: Capability matrix (written in Chinese) cataloging the metadata fields each of ORGII's 8 external AI session loaders (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Windsurf, WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy, Trae, Cline) reads and writes into the unified ImportedHistoryCacheInput cache, used to track AI-blame query readiness per loader.
nodes.languageNotes: Document body is written in Chinese; enumerates capability gaps across 8 distinct external history loader integrations.

nodes.name: orgtrack-protocol-rfc.md
nodes.summary: RFC (Phase 1 implemented) proposing extraction of Orgtrack into a standalone protocol (ResourceInteractionEnvelope v1), vendor adapters, a fail-open collector, pluggable stores, and a conformance suite so the boundary stays usable from a desktop app, local CLI, CI job, or cloud container without depending on Tauri or ORG2 UI types.

nodes.name: session-provenance.md
nodes.summary: Describes the Session Provenance system that tracks which agent session interacted with a resource (files, symbols, URLs, etc.), when, and with what attribution precision, including its local SQLite storage schema (~/.orgii/sessions.db), data flow, historical reconciliation, and privacy boundaries.
